ns2:course.label: Logic Synthesis
ns2:course.description: Unate function theory, unate recursive paradigm, synthesis of two-level logic, synthesis of incompletely specified combinational logic, multi-level logic synthesis, binary decision diagrams, finite state machine synthesis, automatic test pattern generation and design for test, equivalence checking and reachability analysis of finite machines, and technology mapping. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ECE 220 or CS 233.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ECE 220 or CS 233.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Junior, Senior, or Graduate class standing.
